brief.lead_headline: Dispatch logs 47 commits in a single day as audio, podcast, and admin architecture converge
brief.lead_body: Dispatch had its busiest single day on record. Forty-seven commits resolved a run of audio routing failures, graduated the podcast subsystem from scaffolding to a coherent feature, and closed the day by migrating project management logic out of the admin panel and into individual project pages.
